The Hilt setup is test-only: testImplementation(hilt-android-testing), kspTest, a catalog entry and no change to app/dependencies/*ReleaseRuntimeClasspath.txt. feature:settings:api is an api module (II.1).
ExperienceViewModelTest filledList/missingEndDate/empty/orderFollowsStoredOrder. experience_required_fix at 337dp/2.0 shows amber 'Jun 2021 – end date?' and 'Now', with whole-word wrapping.
existingRole_loadsDraftFromEntry and laterProfileEmissions_doNotOverwriteTheDraft. The edit_role 337dp/2.0 baseline stacks Start/End above font scale 1.3 (D40).
currentToggle_savesPresentAndClearsGap and currentToggleOff_restoresTypedEnd. The current_job_on baseline shows End dimmed with the 'Present' hint.

Save stores exactly what was typed (trim only, A finding 4 accepted). Existing roles become USER_EDITED and new roles USER_STATED, both with isConfirmed=true, which TailorResumeUseCase and ReviewedEntries treat as confirmed. An edit replaces only the matching id in a fresh profile read. Save is single-flight (doubleSaveInAddMode_writesOneRoleWithOneId fails without the guard) and ignored while invalid (blankTitle_blocksSaveWithoutWriting, saveInAddModeAtEntryLimit_isBlocked). But FactIdAllocator fills gaps, so after a delete a new role reuses the deleted id (finding 2).

delete_removesEntryAndEmitsDeleted and deleteInAddMode_isNoop (A finding 2 fixed). Delete removes only that id and its bullets. Delete is not single-flight like Save, so a double tap pops two screens (finding 1).

findings.trigger: Edit an existing role and tap 'Delete this role' twice before the first Room write completes. Both coroutines pass 'if (finished)' at line 172, because finished is only set at line 176 after saveProfile. Both send EditRoleEvent.Deleted, and EditRoleRoute calls navigator.goBack() for each event. The second goBack pops Experience, or Review when the editor was opened from #275's Add date, and 'Role deleted' shows twice. Save then Delete in the same window can also resurrect the role, because delete() ignores the saving flag.
findings.title: Delete is not single-flight: a double tap emits two Deleted events and pops an extra screen
findings.proof: RoleViewModelsTest: with the slow repository from doubleSaveInAddMode, call viewModel(existingId).delete() twice inside events.test and assert exactly one Deleted event (expectNoEvents after the first).

findings.rule: Constitution I.1 / scout constraint 'tailored text keeps its stored copy' (cross-lane with tailor ReviewedEntries)
findings.trigger: Profile W-01, W-02, W-03 with an application whose TailoredResume cites W-02 and W-02-b1. Delete W-02, then Add role 'Analyst'. FactIdAllocator.nextId fills the gap (aGapInTheRunIsFilledBeforeCountingUp), so the new role gets W-02 and its first bullet W-02-b1 (nextFreeBulletId). reviewedEntries/TailorUiStateBuilder join stored resumes to the current profile by id. The old application's tailored resume now shows the new role's title, company and dates, and the export pulls the new W-02-b1 bullet. A document the user already approved changes to a different job. This PR adds the first delete path, so this is the first way to free an id and reuse it.
findings.title: A deleted role's id is reused by the next added role, so old tailored resumes attach to the wrong job
findings.proof: EditRoleViewModelTest: delete W-02 from the returning fixture, then add a role in a new ViewModel, and assert the new id is not 'W-02'. The fix allocates past the highest number used, or keeps deleted ids reserved.

findings.rule: D52 'N yrs' (sum of non-overlapping role intervals, floored) / I.1 accurate statement about the candidate
findings.trigger: The end month is treated as exclusive, so each role loses a month. A single role 'Jan 2024 – Dec 2024' shows '0 yrs' (nonExperienceEntries_areIgnored pins 0). 'Jun 2020 – May 2021' shows 0 (lessThanTwelveMonths_floorsToZero, which is actually 12 months). '2020 – 2021' shows 1, and 'Jul 2022 – Jun 2025' shows 2 instead of 3. Roles that end and start on month boundaries are the normal case, so the header understates experience by a year for many profiles.
findings.title: Years of experience counts the end month as exclusive and understates whole years
findings.proof: ProfileOverviewTest: yearsOfExperience(listOf(experience("Jan 2024", "Dec 2024")), clock) == 1 and experience("2020", "2021") == 2. Both fail at this head.
